Phone Photos Random Freelancer AS Agency
Lighting quality Room light & phone flash Depends on the person ✓Studio lighting, designed per product
Platform-ready sizes One size — you crop it yourself Sometimes, if you ask ✓Sized for Daraz, Amazon, TikTok & more
Video ads included No Rarely — usually photos only ✓Photo + video planned together

How It Works

From Brief to Delivery

A simple five-step process — you approve every stage before the final files are delivered.

  1. 1

    Brief

    You share your product, your audience and where the ad will run.

  2. 2

    The idea and, for video, a full 30-second script for your approval.

  3. 3

    Production

    Photos and video are produced in the style you picked.

  4. 4

    Revisions

    You review the work and request changes until it feels right.

  5. 5

    Final Delivery

    Finished files, sized and ready to post on every platform.

You approve the preview before final delivery — no surprises.

Questions

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything clients usually ask before their first order.

How do I start?

Message us on WhatsApp with your product name and what you want to promote.

What do you need from me?

Your product details; photos or a logo if you have them — if not, we will guide you.

Which sizes will I get?

Vertical 9:16 for Reels & TikTok, 1:1 and 4:5 for feeds, 16:9 for YouTube — matched to where you will post.

How do I receive my files?

By WhatsApp and a download link, ready to post.

Do you work outside Pakistan?

Yes — national and international clients, everything is handled online.

What do I need to start?

Just your product photos and details — or send us the product itself. We guide you through every step from there.

Which sizes/formats do I get?

Files sized for Daraz, Amazon, Shopify, TikTok, Reels and YouTube — every format matched to where you will post.

Can you work with sellers outside Pakistan?

Yes — we deliver nationally across Pakistan and internationally worldwide, with the whole process handled over WhatsApp and email.
